remaining_work: The website snapshot is a proposal. All 90 contracts and their candidate NL–FL IDs remain subject to independent mathematical review; source extraction and a public name do not approve a mathematical contract.

M08 retains the original generic statement and namespace, exported from the existing ThetaMassey file. The fixed ActualE2At/actualE2Product signature and a computation-owned source file are not introduced by this mechanical boundary change.

M16 uses the existing single fixed Challenge2 witness. The website proposal quantifies over arbitrary input : Challenge2; parameterizing all prerequisite public lemmas is separate mathematical/API work.

The existing M03 shifted_finite_source_exists theorem retains its SyntheticInputs premise. The website proposal asks for only DifferentialRigidity and FiniteQuotientPageVanishing; narrowing this premise is not claimed here.
Existing standard E2 definitions retain their current exposure. Changing actualE2Product or model definitional equality requires consumer review, not a bulk no_expose rewrite.
A shared file is a shared compilation unit. Registering one public theorem does not isolate it from edits to other public declarations in that same file.
Ordinary imports still inherit a provider’s public reexports. Common remains tied to the same standard foundation; its direct-import reduction is not a proof of a small transitive public surface.
Keep docs/external-inputs.json as the sole source/input provenance manifest. This file records design references and import policy only; the pending PR #3 milestone scheduler is not duplicated.
Build-isolation evidence must come from same-environment warm-cache proof-only and public-interface edits; source import checks or historical CI timing differences do not measure speedup.
